page.layout: One printed page, title page. Centred title block in roman and italic type, with the imprint at the foot. Two engravings between the title and the imprint: a medallion portrait on the left and a tree with ribbon banner on the right. No margins with text.

l.i: Necessaires d'estre sçeuës, pour la conserua-

main_text.l: Par vn Ancien Docteur en Medecine,
Chez GASPAR METVRAS, rué S. Iacques,
à la Trinité, prés les Maturins.

page.notes: Engravings: left, an oval medallion with a profile portrait of Hippocrates, with a ring inscription along the top and left (partly legible: "DE SANTE DE PARIS" and "...PRIMEIRE ANTIE") and a Greek banner along the bottom reading roughly "ΙΠΠΟΚΡΑΤΗΣ"; the exact letters of the ring inscription are not certain, so they are not transcribed. Right, a tree with a ribbon scroll bearing partly legible words ("VIRID", "QVID", "IN", "ARD") that are too faint to read reliably; not transcribed. Not transcribed as printed text: the handwritten name "par Jean Riolan" across the top of the medallion, the shelf mark "32.594" at the right, and the ruler at the foot. The printed title page shows no page number, running head, catchword or signature.
